90K likes, 744 comments - lokhandeankita on October 12, 2026: "Pyaari Neha, happy  birthday❤️✨

My best friend, my sister, and my forever cheerleader you make life brighter just by being in it. I love your energy, your beautiful heart, your honesty, and the way you inspire me to be my best. And girl, you’re gorgeous and sexy as hell! 🔥😍

Keep being your chirpy, happy, fearless self. 
Keep dancing, dreaming big, laughing loudly, and lighting up every room with that beautiful smile of yours.

May God bless you with abundance, prosperity, confidence, endless love, and so many wonderful reasons to celebrate. Here’s to more adventures, silly moments, and memories together! 🥂

So lucky to call you my best friend. I love you forever, meri @nehaswamibijlani 😘😘😘🧿🧿🧿".
